धनुष की एक्शन थ्रिलर फिल्म OM ने दूसरे दिन भी बॉक्स ऑफिस पर अपना जलवा बरकरार रखा है! 🔥

Early trends के मुताबिक शनिवार को फिल्म ने 15.5 से 16 crore net का कलेक्शन किया है। 💥

Day 1 के 18.1 crore के मुकाबले कमाई में 11.6% से 14.36% की मामूली गिरावट आई है।

अब दो दिनों में फिल्म का कुल Indian box office net कलेक्शन 33.6 से 34.1 crore हो चुका है।

इसी के साथ फिल्म ने Baththa और Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil जैसी Kollywood फिल्मों को पछाड़ दिया है। 📊

Tamil version में occupancy 48% रही, जबकि 200 crore के बजट में बनी इस फिल्म का Hindi occupancy 16-17% रहा।

ctx.title: OM Box Office Day 2 (Early Trends): Beats Baththa & Two Other Kollywood Successes Of 2026!
ctx.summary:
Dhanush-led OM maintained good hold at the Indian box office on its first Saturday (day 2), earning over 15 crore+ net. 
 The post  OM Box Office Day 2 (Early Trends): Beats Baththa & Two Other Kollywood Successes Of 2026!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After a solid start at the Indian box office, Dhanush-led OM had another good day on its first Saturday. Due to the Saturday boost, collections had scope to grow, but it didn’t. However, collections still remained healthy. In the meantime, the film has surpassed the 30 crore net mark in its first two days and has surpassed the lifetime collections of Baththa and two other successful Kollywood films in 2026. Keep reading to know what early trends have to suggest!
In the original Tamil version, the Kollywood spy action thriller recorded an average occupancy of around 48% throughout the day. In the Telugu version, the recorded occupancy is 38%, with the reports for the night shows yet to come. The Hindi version remained below par with an average occupancy of 16-17%. With occupancy down compared to opening day, collections naturally declined.
As per early trends, OM is closing day 2 at 15.5-16 crore . Compared to day 1’s 18.1 crore , it witnessed a drop of 14.36-11.6%. Overall, the film has earned 33.6-34.1 crore net at the Indian box office. It equals 39.65-40.24 crore gross.
With 33.6-34.1 crore net in the kitty, OM has surpassed Baththa ( 30.31 crore ), Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil ( 30.13 crore ), and With Love ( 30.72 crore ) at the Indian box office. In its opening weekend, the Dhanush starrer is likely to hit the 50 crore net mark and cross LIK: Love Insurance Kompany ( 43.07 crore ) and Gatta Kusthi 2 ( 41.66 crore ).
OM is directed by Rajkumar Periasamy and produced by Dhanush, Shraddha Agrawal, and Azmat Jagmag under the banner of Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios. It also stars Mammootty, Sai Pallavi, Sreeleela, Naseeruddin Shah, and Indrans in key roles. The film was reportedly made on a budget of 200 crore .
